versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the seo-hreflang skill.
- Provides tools to audit, validate, and generate hreflang tags for international and multi-language SEO.
- Detects common implementation mistakes (invalid/self-referencing/return tags, language and region code errors, protocol/canonical mismatches).
- Supports HTML, HTTP header, and XML sitemap hreflang implementations.
- Includes detailed code validation guidelines and implementation instructions.
- User-invocable and suitable for sites of all sizes and structures.
